rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something holds or attracts someone’s attention or interest.

example.traditional: 呢個故仔好吸引小朋友。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gu3 zai2 hou2 kap1 jan5 siu2 pang4 jau5

rows.note: Use this for engaging or hiring a person to work, rather than for engaging a space or machine.

example.english: We’ll engage a new manager for the shop.
example.traditional: 我哋會請個新店長返嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 ceng2 go3 san1 dim3 zoeng2 faan1 lei4

rows.note: Use this specifically when engage means formally promise to marry.

example.english: They plan to engage next month.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 haa6 go3 jyut6 ding6 fan1

rows.note: Use this when engaging someone means getting them into a conversation.

example.english: I want to engage you in conversation.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 tung4 nei5 king1 gai2
